lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate a haggling duel in a Russian garage cooperative like a western movie narrator: slow, dramatic, dry irony. «Лексус эл эс четыреста» — Lexus LS 400. Numbers said fully.

slava.profile: Slava — a young Russian car buyer in his late 20s, cheeky but polite, confident haggler.
slava.notes: Line 1: smug, pointing at rusty sills. Line 2: casual, showing the phone, a calm fact. Line 3: happy, short: «По рукам!»

arkady.profile: Grandpa Arkady — an old cunning Russian man in his 70s, mustache, glasses and a cap, sells his car in his garage.
arkady.notes: Line 1: proud, theatrical. Line 2: offended, then grudging concession. Line 3: sly, triumphant, calls the buyer «внучок». Line 4: friendly, deal-making.
